<translate>
The '''Anti-Ki Cloaking Device''' hides your Battle Power while you wear it in the '''Head Tech''' Curios slot. It is the reward of Bulma's '''Cloaking Device''' sidequest.

<translate>
== What it hides ==

While you wear it:

* [[Special:MyLanguage/Scouters|Scouters]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]] can't read you;
* other players can't use [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]] to reach you;
* party markers don't show you.
